label: Bible Study
prompt: If we confess our sins, he is _____ and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
note: Confession meets a faithful God — and the cleansing covers all unrighteousness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Many _____ cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verse: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
note: Many waters cannot quench it, and no fortune can buy it — love's two best qualities in one verse.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not _____.
verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
note: The burning bush's real wonder wasn't the fire — it was that the bush was not consumed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A double minded man is _____ in all his ways.
verse: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
note: James's doubter is tossed like a wave — 'double minded' is literally 'two-souled' in the Greek.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Bring ye all the tithes into the _____, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
verse: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
note: God invites a test: bring the tithes into the 'storehouse,' then watch heaven's windows. Stewardship Sunday's anchor.
